description:
AI-powered next-generation cross-platform multithreaded downloader.

A cross-platform fluent-design AI-boost multi-threaded downloader built with Python.
Tip
Join the Ghost Downloader community on Discord: discord.gg/fKfhkPumEM
New Features 🎉
- The new task dialog now auto-focuses the input field and pastes matching download links from the clipboard By @XiaoYouChR
- Dragging plain-text URLs onto the main window now creates download tasks By @XiaoYouChR
Improvements 🔧
- Updated translations (#777) By @i0ntempest
Bug Fixes 🐛
- Fixed BitTorrent download performance issues caused by incorrect libtorrent session defaults By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed runtime installation failures showing a generic error instead of the actual reason By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the time-range slider label using a pixel font on Windows By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed copying a download link on macOS triggering duplicate detection By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed dragging a file from the task list triggering the main window's drop handler By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed the system sleep prevention feature not working on Linux By @XiaoYouChR
- Fixed _pending directories causing feature packs to load twice By @XiaoYouChR
Feature Pack Updates 📦
> The following updates may have already been delivered via automatic pack updates.
- bili_pack 1.1.3 — Error messages now support localization By @XiaoYouChR
- ed2k_pack 1.1.1 — Error messages now support localization By @XiaoYouChR
- m3u8_pack 1.0.2 — Improved error classification for additional failure scenarios By @XiaoYouChR
- yt_dlp_pack 1.1.1 — Error messages now support localization By @XiaoYouChR
- http_pack 1.0.1 — Error messages now support localization By @XiaoYouChR
- ftp_pack 1.0.1 — Error messages now support localization By @XiaoYouChR
- ffmpeg_pack 1.0.1 — Error messages now support localization By @XiaoYouChR
- huggingface_pack 1.0.1 — Fixed importing from the seed http_pack (#779) By @i0ntempest
